limitations: Flat/no randomization. Replicas are translated nominal copies, not a robustness confidence interval. Knee metric is joint-origin height, not collision-surface clearance. Contacts use >1N normal force history at 50Hz samples. No hardware conclusion or per-reward causality claim.
drift_definition: Signed/absolute heading change and actual root displacement across the starting heading, from the first valid sample after 2s to the final valid first-episode sample. Heading change is only unwanted drift when the requested yaw rate is zero.
